1922, December 16
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
/POST CARD/
Praised Be Jesus Christ!
Our Lady Queen of Angels December 16# 1922 226 E. 113 St N.Y. City, N.Y.
My Dear Brother and Sister Owen and Martha:
The returned letter herewith inclosed will partly explain my silence at your sorrows last August. But though silent, I have not been al- together unmindful of your bereavement. However we may confidently trust in God to manifest some day a merciful design - not only in your case of such sorrow but in every case where He has per- mitted suffering in order that little children may come to Him. How happy you ought to be in reality this holy season! to have your little Owen, not only an altar boy, but one of the great heavenly army of holy Innocents. In this thought, while in another sense I condole with you, I wish you a holy and a happy Blessed Christmastide!
Sincerely in the Sacred Heart,
Fr. Solanus, O.M. Cap.
Deo Gratias
